Hi Jenna / Vertex procurement team,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get Vertex Supply set up so we can start sending POs and move forward with onboarding. To get the vendor created in our AP and to confirm PO/terms, can you please return the following items by end of week? We’ll start the PO creation and payment routing once we have the required docs.

1) Legal entity name (as registered) and DBA if applicable
2) Remit-to address for invoices (street, city, state, ZIP, country)
3) Federal Tax ID / VAT number and tax classification (1099 vendor? LLC/S-corp/etc)
4) Bank details for ACH (bank name, account number, routing/ABA) OR wire instructions (bank, SWIFT, account) — if sending ACH we also need a voided check or bank letter
5) Point of contact for invoice escalation (name, email, phone)
6) If you require specific PO terms (net30, net45, billing contact) or a PO reference format
7) Sample invoice PDF so we can validate remit and tax fields

I’ve attached our vendor intake template (Redwood_vendor_intake_template.xlsx) to make this easier. If any of the items are sensitive, feel free to upload via the DocuSign/secure link below or send via your vendor portal.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/47829

Thanks — Rafael

Rafael — thanks for the forward. I reviewed their intake and attached docs. Below is the AP setup checklist and our recommended sequence. I attached AP_vendor_setup_checklist.pdf for records.

AP vendor setup checklist (summary):
- Verify W-9 legal name + EIN against intake form (OK)
- Confirm remit-to mailing address via business registry (we checked CA SOS)
- Verify voided check vs ACH account name; if mismatch request bank letter signed by bank (we have voided check but bank letter still required for first-time vendors > $50k monthly)
- Tax classification set to Vendor Type: Corporation (1099 not applicable)
- Create vendor code: VRTX-00089 (I’ll create this afternoon)
- PO terms: Net30 default; request PO approval chain: Purchasing Manager + Director for invoices > $10k
- Add invoice routing to ap@vertexsupply.com; enable email-to-AP and link to PO number field
- Required fields in our vendor record: legal entity, EIN, remit-to, preferred payment method, AP contact, W9 file, bank confirmation file

Next steps and timeline:
1) I will create vendor record and upload W9 and intake today (by 3pm PT).
2) Kim — can you confirm if we require a signed MSA for vendors supplying hardware components? If yes, route to Legal; if not, we’ll proceed with intake + W9.
3) Rafael — once vendor code created I’ll notify you and finance will set up ACH terms.

Notes on ACH: we require either a bank letter or two independent verification documents (voided check + bank portal screenshot). We can accept the voided check for now but will request bank letter within 30 days.
